description: This script is used for relocating SDK binaries by modifying interpreter paths, system directories, and ld.so.cache paths within ELF binaries during SDK installation.

methods.name: get_arch
methods.description: Determines the architecture (32-bit or 64-bit) of the ELF binary by reading its header.

methods.name: parse_elf_header
methods.description: Parses the ELF header to extract key information such as type, machine, entry point, and section headers.

methods.name: change_interpreter
methods.description: Locates and modifies the interpreter path in ELF binaries to point to a new dynamic loader path.

methods.name: change_dl_sysdirs
methods.description: Modifies system directory paths and ld.so.cache paths within ELF binaries to update library search paths.
